reviews.text:
Bennett deserves a huge shoutout! I have a hot tub, and it was being serviced by a company for the past year or so. They kept raising our prices to the point where I told myself that I wanted to see how hard it would be for me to do it on my own. I went into Simplified Pools and the rest is history!

Bennett helped me truly understand how to service my hot tub, and Simplified Pools had all the supplies I needed in order to do so.

I now feel incredibly confident, and will continue to rely on Simplified Pools for all my hot tub maintenance needs from this point forward!
reviews.author: Matt Stedron

reviews.text: We have a 70+ lb. tortoise that would easily fall in and drown if we had an in-ground pool so we bought our kids an above ground Intex pool after they got sick at our community pool. I stopped here for chlorine and test strips and was very pleased with the service I received. The lady who helped me was very nice, helpful, and immediately greeted me as I arrived. This store is clean, well organized, and in a convenient location. They have a good variety of treatment options for both fresh and saltwater pools. I like that they also have other pool accessories and even gave each of my kids free drink can flamingo floats. We will definitely continue coming here for our pool needs.
reviews.author: Nikki Robbin

reviews.text: We love Simplified Pools! Their team is always friendly, reliable, and super knowledgeable. Can’t recommend them enough if you want your pool to stay clean and balanced without the stress!
reviews.author: Brooke Hamilton

reviews.text: We love everything about this place, they have helped to keep our pool clean and sanitized. Great customer service too.  Thank you for always helping us. - Todd & Pam xo
reviews.author: Pam Christian

reviews.text: Great service!!! Always friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating. It’s great to trust them and just enjoy the pool. You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Matthew Bissell

reviews.text: Simplified Pools has been integral to helping us learn to care for our pool. They offer free water testing and print out what is needed to balance the pool chemicals. They sell all the chemicals you need in the store. Easy, convenient, and most importantly friendly service.
reviews.author: Tiffany Wishert

reviews.text: Outstanding customer service. Bennett is always incredibly helpful when I stop in.
reviews.author: Zak Lehn

reviews.text: This is our first pool to ever own and Simplified Pools has definitely helped us through the process of getting it up and ready for swim season. During the winter months, our pool had issues and froze over, Jim and Nick came out while there was ice on the ground and very cold conditions! Jim and Nick are very reliable and very professional and offer great suggestions on how to keep the pool crispy clean! I highly recommend their service!
reviews.author: simon warren

data.summary: The available reviews for Simplified Pools appear authentic and positive, with specific details and varied customer experiences. The primary concern is the relatively low volume of reviews (36 on Google, 3 on Yelp) for a business that appears to offer retail and service, and the lack of any critical feedback in the sample, which is unusual. There is no evidence of review manipulation or significant complaint patterns. The business seems to be a well-regarded local pool store and service provider.
